prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A whimsical cartoon scene set in a sunny, rural farmyard. In the foreground, two anthropomorphic chickens stand facing each other, both with expressive, exaggerated features. The chicken on the left is white with a red comb and wattle, wide-eyed and looking slightly anxious, holding a large wicker basket filled with eggs. The chicken on the right is brown, also with a red comb, gesturing emphatically with one wing and wearing an exasperated expression. A speech bubble above the brown chicken reads, "HOW MANY TIMES HAVE I TOLD YOU NOT TO PUT ALL THE CHILDREN IN ONE BASKET?!", adding a humorous twist. In the background, a simple wooden chicken coop and a green wire fence are visible, with soft green grass and a clear blue sky completing the pastoral setting. The color palette is warm and earthy, with soft shading and clean black outlines, evoking a lighthearted, comic strip style. The composition is balanced, focusing on the interaction and expressions of the chickens, with a slight depth of field that keeps the background elements simple and unobtrusive.
